Table Name: automatic_transactions
Business Description: Automated bank transfer logs and payment gateway reference responses.
Primary Key: id
Date Filtering Columns: created_at, updated_at
Aggregation Numerical Columns: amount
Common Join Conditions:
  - automatic_transactions.user_id = users.id
- withdrawal_request.automatic_transaction_id = automatic_transactions.id

Columns Schema:
  - id (bigint) (PRIMARY KEY) Nullable: NO
  - user_id (bigint) Nullable: NO
  - reference_id (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - transaction_id (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - transfer_type (varchar) Nullable: NO
  - res_code (longtext) Nullable: NO
  - status (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - users_phone_number (varchar) Nullable: NO
  - users_account_number (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - created_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - updated_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - amount (double) Nullable: NO
  - bank_reference_number (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - response_data (longtext) Nullable: YES
  - transaction_source (varchar) Nullable: YES

Table Name: companies
Business Description: Enterprise company profiles, business units, and SAP company mappings.
Primary Key: id
Date Filtering Columns: created_at, updated_at
Aggregation Numerical Columns: monthly_percent_deactivate_qr_limit
Common Join Conditions:
  - companies.customer_id = users.id

Columns Schema:
  - id (bigint) (PRIMARY KEY) Nullable: NO
  - name (varchar) Nullable: NO
  - phone (bigint) Nullable: YES
  - email (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - sap_code (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - business_unit (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - jgh_company (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - image (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - created_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - updated_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - business_info_id (bigint) Nullable: YES
  - customer_id (bigint) Nullable: NO
  - monthly_percent_deactivate_qr_limit (decimal) Nullable: NO
  - additional_monthly_deactivate_qr_limit (int) Nullable: NO
  - additional_limit_valid_upto (date) Nullable: YES

Table Name: sku_inventories
Business Description: Catalog of stock units, SKU codes, prices, invoices, and distributor inventory details.
Primary Key: id
Date Filtering Columns: created_at, updated_at, invoice_date, order_date, wholesaler_scanned_at, retailer_scanned_at
Aggregation Numerical Columns: unit_price, invoiced_quantity, packed_quantity
Common Join Conditions:
  - sku_inventories.distributer_id = users.id

Columns Schema:
  - id (bigint) (PRIMARY KEY) Nullable: NO
  - mrp (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - sku_code (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - unit_price (decimal) Nullable: YES

  - packed_quantity (int) Nullable: NO

  - product_id (bigint) Nullable: YES
  - uom (varchar) Nullable: YES

  - invoice_date (date) Nullable: YES
  - warehouse (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - invoiced_by (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - order_date (date) Nullable: YES
  - customer_info (json) Nullable: YES
  - distributer_id (bigint) Nullable: YES

  - updated_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - is_callback (tinyint) Nullable: NO
  - status_wholeseller_id (bigint) Nullable: YES
  - status_retailer_id (bigint) Nullable: YES
  - sources (varchar) Nullable: NO
  - wholesaler_scanned_at (datetime) Nullable: YES
  - retailer_scanned_at (datetime) Nullable: YES
  - is_active (tinyint) Nullable: NO
  - is_offline (tinyint) Nullable: NO

Table Name: wallet_transaction
Business Description: Financial ledger of user wallet credits, debits, scans, and rewards.
Primary Key: id
Date Filtering Columns: created_at, updated_at
Aggregation Numerical Columns: amount
Common Join Conditions:
  - wallet_transaction.user_id = users.id

Columns Schema:
  - id (bigint) (PRIMARY KEY) Nullable: NO
  - user_id (int) Nullable: NO
  - amount (decimal) Nullable: NO
  - transaction_type (tinyint) Nullable: NO
  - reference_id (int) Nullable: YES
  - reference_type (enum) Nullable: YES
  - status (tinyint) Nullable: NO
  - remark (varchar) Nullable: NO
  - created_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - updated_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES

Table Name: withdrawal_request
Business Description: User payout and cash withdrawal requests log.
Primary Key: id
Date Filtering Columns: created_at, updated_at
Aggregation Numerical Columns: amount, tds_amount, tds_deducted_amount
Common Join Conditions:
  - withdrawal_request.user_id = users.id
- withdrawal_request.automatic_transaction_id = automatic_transactions.id

Columns Schema:
  - id (bigint) (PRIMARY KEY) Nullable: NO
  - user_id (int) Nullable: NO
  - amount (int) Nullable: NO
  - bank_transaction_id (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - delivery_proof (varchar) Nullable: YES
  - status (tinyint) Nullable: NO
  - created_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - updated_at (timestamp) Nullable: YES
  - automatic_transaction_id (bigint) Nullable: NO
  - tds_amount (decimal) Nullable: NO
  - tds_deducted_amount (decimal) Nullable: YES
  - gift_order_id (bigint) Nullable: YES
  - withdraw_request_type (varchar) Nullable: YES
